```typescript
function smoothPath(points: Point[], smoothingFactor = 0.3): string {
  if (points.length < 3) return pointsToPath(points);
  
  const smoothed: Point[] = [points[0]];
  
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
    const prev = points[i - 1];
    const curr = points[i];
    const next = points[i + 1];
    
    smoothed.push({
      x: curr.x + (prev.x + next.x - 2 * curr.x) * smoothingFactor,
      y: curr.y + (prev.y + next.y - 2 * curr.y) * smoothingFactor
    });
  }
  
  smoothed.push(points[points.length - 1]);
  return catmullRomToPath(smoothed);
}
```

tasks.details: Implement water treatment process symbols: clarifiers with mechanisms (rake, suction, chain-and-flight), rapid gravity filters with backwash systems, GAC/sand/multimedia filters, chlorine contact tanks with baffles, UV disinfection units with lamp configurations, ozone generators and contactors. Create pumping station components: wet well/dry well configurations, submersible/vertical turbine pumps, variable speed drives, surge vessels. Build distribution system symbols: PRV stations, flow meters (electromagnetic, ultrasonic), sampling points, analyzer shelters, chlorination injection points, reservoir level controls. Implement SCADA/telemetry symbols: RTUs, radio masts, HMI screens, control panels. Create sludge treatment symbols: digesters (anaerobic/aerobic), dewatering equipment (centrifuge, belt press), thickeners. Store company-specific variations in separate namespaces. Implement symbol mapping between different water company standards using conversion matrices.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate against actual water company P&ID standards, test symbol conversion between standards, verify water-specific process logic, test SCADA symbol interactions, validate treatment process symbol sequences

tasks.title: Build Symbol Search, Discovery and Organization System
tasks.description: Implement advanced search capabilities with full-text search, visual similarity matching, smart categories, and AI-powered recommendations
tasks.details: Implement full-text search using PostgreSQL tsvector with weighted ranking (name: A, description: B, tags: C). Create visual similarity search using perceptual hashing (pHash) stored as PostgreSQL cube data type for efficient similarity queries. Build faceted search interface with React InstantSearch components supporting filters by category, standard, size range, pressure rating, material. Implement smart categories using ML.NET clustering (K-means) based on usage patterns. Create favorites system with user preferences stored in PostgreSQL with Redis caching. Build recent items tracking using Redis sorted sets with TTL. Implement AI-powered recommendations using collaborative filtering (symbols frequently used together). Add search analytics tracking using Application Insights. Create search suggestions using PostgreSQL trigram similarity (pg_trgm extension). Implement search result ranking using TF-IDF scoring. Support Boolean search operators (AND, OR, NOT). Add search history with autocomplete.
tasks.testStrategy: Test search relevance using NDCG metrics, validate visual similarity accuracy, test faceted filter combinations, verify recommendation quality, load test with 10000+ concurrent searches, test search suggestion accuracy

tasks.title: Implement Symbol Transformation and Behavior System
tasks.description: Create intelligent symbol behaviors including rotation, flipping, resizing, status indication, live data display, and conditional formatting
tasks.details: Implement rotation system with 15-degree increments using CSS transforms with GPU acceleration. Create text auto-orientation keeping labels readable at any rotation angle using canvas measureText API. Build intelligent flipping system preserving connection points and text readability. Implement aspect-ratio locked resizing with proportional scaling using ResizeObserver API. Create LOD system with three detail levels: simplified (zoom < 0.5), standard (0.5-2.0), detailed (> 2.0). Add status indication system (running/stopped/standby/alarm) using CSS animations and state machines (XState library). Implement live data binding displaying process values from SignalR hub with 1-second update rate. Create conditional formatting engine with rule-based visual alerts (color changes, blinking, badges) based on threshold values. Build property inheritance system for symbol families using prototype chain pattern. Implement undo/redo system for transformations using Command pattern with immutable state.
tasks.testStrategy: Test rotation accuracy at all angles, verify text readability after transformations, test LOD transitions smoothness, validate live data update latency < 100ms, test conditional formatting rule evaluation, verify undo/redo state consistency

tasks.title: Create Symbol Import/Export and CAD Integration System
tasks.description: Develop comprehensive import/export functionality supporting DWG/DXF formats, symbol packages, and cross-system compatibility
tasks.details: Implement DWG/DXF parser using dxf-parser and writer using dxf-writer libraries for AutoCAD integration. Create symbol mapping engine translating between CAD blocks and ReactFlow nodes using mapping tables stored in PostgreSQL. Build layer preservation system maintaining CAD layer organization in ReactFlow groups. Implement property mapping between CAD attributes and symbol metadata using XSLT transformations. Create symbol package format (.espkg) as ZIP archives containing symbols.json manifest, SVG files, metadata, and thumbnails. Build import wizard with conflict resolution (skip, replace, rename) and preview. Implement bulk export with selective symbol inclusion. Add version control for symbol libraries using semantic versioning with migration scripts. Create symbol sharing system with organization/team libraries stored in Azure Blob Storage. Implement symbol validation ensuring imported symbols meet quality standards (valid SVG, required metadata). Support batch conversion between standards using parallel processing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test DWG/DXF round-trip accuracy, validate CAD attribute preservation, test symbol package integrity, verify cross-system compatibility, test large file imports (>100MB), validate version migration paths

tasks.title: Develop Performance Optimization and Rendering System
tasks.description: Optimize rendering performance for 1000+ symbols maintaining 60fps with progressive loading, virtualization, and GPU acceleration
tasks.details: Implement virtual scrolling for symbol library using react-window with fixed-size grid. Create progressive symbol loading with intersection observer loading symbols in viewport + 200px buffer. Build WebGL-accelerated rendering for complex symbols using Pixi.js as ReactFlow custom renderer. Implement symbol instancing for repeated symbols sharing geometry reducing memory usage by 70%. Create dirty rectangle optimization only re-rendering changed regions. Add request animation frame batching for smooth 60fps updates. Implement Web Worker offloading for SVG path calculations and collision detection. Create memory pooling for symbol instances reusing objects to reduce GC pressure. Build level-of-detail (LOD) system with automatic quality adjustment based on performance metrics. Implement texture atlasing for symbol thumbnails reducing draw calls. Add lazy compilation for complex symbols using dynamic imports. Create performance monitoring dashboard using Performance API tracking FPS, memory usage, render time. Implement adaptive quality settings automatically adjusting based on device capabilities.
tasks.testStrategy: Load test with 1000+ symbols measuring FPS stability, memory profiling for leak detection, test virtualization with rapid scrolling, benchmark WebGL vs SVG rendering, validate LOD transitions, stress test with continuous updates

tasks.title: Create PropertyManager service for centralized property management
tasks.description: Implement a comprehensive PropertyManager service that handles property validation, calculation, templates, and metadata management across the property panel system
tasks.details: Create PropertyManager.ts at frontend/src/services/ that provides centralized management for all property operations. Implement property validation using Zod schemas, property calculation engine using engineering formulas, property templates system with default values per equipment type, metadata system for property display configuration, tag number generation and management with auto-incrementing sequences, bulk property operations with transaction support, and property history tracking for undo/redo. Use React 19.1.0's features, TypeScript 5.x strict mode, and integrate with existing Zustand store pattern. The service should handle cross-field validations, unit conversions between metric/imperial, and calculated properties like Reynolds number, pressure drop, and flow velocity. Reference existing propertySchemas.ts and integrate with the current PropertyPanel.tsx component.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for all calculation formulas, validation rules, and tag number generation. Integration tests for bulk operations and template application. Test property persistence, undo/redo functionality, and cross-field validations. Verify metric/imperial conversions are accurate to engineering standards.

tasks.title: Implement property field components with validation and unit conversion
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive set of form field components that handle different property types with real-time validation, unit conversion, and calculated field updates
tasks.details: Develop DynamicFormField.tsx and supporting field components in frontend/src/components/drawing/PropertyPanel/FormFields/. Implement field types: TextInput (with pattern validation), NumberInput (with range and precision), UnitInput (with automatic conversion), Dropdown (with searchable options), Checkbox, RadioGroup, DatePicker (using date-fns v4.1.0), ColorPicker (using react-colorful v5.6.1), FormulaEditor (with syntax highlighting), and TableEditor (for multi-row data). Each field should support: real-time validation with error messages, unit conversion between metric/imperial systems, dependency tracking for calculated fields, disabled/readonly states, placeholder and helper text, and accessibility with proper ARIA labels. Use react-hook-form v7.63.0 for form management and @hookform/resolvers v5.2.2 for Zod integration. Ensure all fields follow the FieldConfiguration interface pattern and integrate with PropertyManager service.
tasks.testStrategy: Component tests for each field type using React Testing Library. Test validation rules, unit conversions, and error states. Verify accessibility with screen reader testing. Test cross-field dependencies and calculated field updates. Performance tests for large forms with many fields.

tasks.title: Build property template system with industry standards
tasks.description: Implement a comprehensive template management system with pre-built templates for standard equipment following ISA and industry specifications
tasks.details: Create PropertyTemplates.ts in frontend/src/components/drawing/PropertyPanel/ with template definitions for standard equipment. Implement templates for: pumps (centrifugal, positive displacement, vacuum), valves (gate, globe, ball, butterfly, check), vessels (horizontal, vertical, storage tanks), heat exchangers (shell-tube, plate, air-cooled), instruments (pressure, temperature, flow, level transmitters), and piping (various schedules and materials). Each template should include: default property values per equipment type, locked properties that cannot be edited, required fields validation, calculated properties formulas, industry standard compliance (ISA-5.1, ISO 14617), and material compatibility rules. Build TemplateManager component for UI with template selection dropdown, preview of template properties, batch application to multiple elements, custom template creation and saving, and organization-wide template sharing. Store templates in localStorage with JSON export/import capability.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for template validation and property application. Integration tests for batch template application. Test template persistence and import/export. Verify industry standard compliance for default values.

tasks.title: Implement advanced calculation engine for engineering properties
tasks.description: Build a comprehensive calculation engine that handles complex engineering formulas, unit conversions, and cross-property dependencies in real-time
tasks.details: Develop CalculationEngine.ts in frontend/src/services/ with support for engineering calculations. Implement formulas for: fluid dynamics (Reynolds number, pressure drop, flow velocity, Bernoulli equation), heat transfer (heat duty, LMTD, overall heat transfer coefficient), pump calculations (NPSH available/required, pump power, efficiency), valve sizing (Cv/Kv calculations, pressure recovery), material properties (density at temperature, viscosity corrections), and pipe sizing (velocity limits, erosional velocity). Build dependency graph for automatic recalculation when input properties change. Implement unit conversion system supporting: SI units, Imperial units, custom unit definitions, and automatic conversion in calculations. Add formula editor with: syntax highlighting for variables and functions, autocomplete for available properties, validation of formula syntax, preview of calculated results, and error handling for division by zero or invalid inputs. Integrate with PropertyManager to trigger calculations on property changes.
tasks.testStrategy: Extensive unit tests for all engineering formulas with known test cases. Test unit conversion accuracy to 6 decimal places. Integration tests for dependency tracking and recalculation. Performance tests for complex calculation graphs with 50+ properties.

tasks.title: Create bulk editing interface with conflict resolution
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive bulk editing capabilities with intelligent conflict resolution for multi-element selection
tasks.details: Enhance PropertyPanel.tsx with BulkEditingPanel component for multi-selection scenarios. Implement features: smart property display showing only common properties across selected elements, mixed value indication with placeholder text like '<mixed>', conflict resolution UI with options to keep existing, apply to all, or apply conditionally, batch operations including find/replace, increment/decrement, apply formulas, and clear values. Add pattern-based selection with filters by type, property value, regex patterns, and spatial proximity. Implement transaction system for atomic bulk updates with rollback on validation failure. Create BulkEditDialog component with: preview of changes before applying, validation summary showing errors/warnings, progress bar for large operations, and undo capability for entire batch. Use React 19.1.0's concurrent features for non-blocking updates on large selections.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests for bulk operations on 100+ elements. Test conflict resolution logic with various scenarios. Performance tests ensuring UI remains responsive during bulk updates. Test transaction rollback on validation failures.

tasks.title: Develop real-time validation system with visual feedback
tasks.description: Build a comprehensive validation framework with immediate visual feedback, cross-field dependencies, and industry standard compliance checking
tasks.details: Create ValidationEngine.ts in frontend/src/services/ implementing multi-level validation. Build validation rules: required field checking, range validation (min/max), pattern matching with regex, custom validation functions, cross-field dependencies (e.g., operating pressure < design pressure), and industry standard compliance (ASME, API, ISO). Implement visual feedback system with: color-coded field borders (red for error, yellow for warning, blue for info), inline error messages with icons, validation summary panel, and real-time validation as user types. Add engineering constraint checking for: material compatibility (temperature/pressure ratings), flow regime validation (laminar/turbulent), safety factor compliance, and design code requirements. Create ValidationRuleBuilder for declarative rule definition using Zod v4.1.11 schemas. Implement async validation for complex checks with loading states. Add validation presets for different industries (oil & gas, water treatment, chemical processing).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for all validation rules and constraint checks. Test async validation with mocked delays. Integration tests for cross-field validation scenarios. Test visual feedback rendering and accessibility of error messages.

tasks.title: Build property search and filtering system
tasks.description: Implement advanced search and filtering capabilities within the property panel to quickly locate and modify specific properties
tasks.details: Create PropertySearch.tsx component in frontend/src/components/drawing/PropertyPanel/ with advanced search features. Implement search capabilities: fuzzy search for property names and values, regex pattern matching, search history with recent searches, saved search queries, and search across multiple selected elements. Add filtering options: filter by property category (basic, process, mechanical, electrical), value ranges for numeric properties, property state (filled, empty, calculated, validated), and modification status (recently changed, user-modified, template-applied). Build search results UI with: highlighted matching terms, grouped results by category, quick actions (edit, clear, copy), and keyboard navigation through results. Implement search indexing for performance using a client-side search index. Add export of search results to CSV/JSON format.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for search algorithms and filtering logic. Performance tests with 1000+ properties. Test fuzzy search accuracy and regex pattern matching. Verify keyboard navigation and accessibility.

tasks.title: Implement property panel docking and layout system
tasks.description: Create a flexible docking system for the property panel with resizable, collapsible, and auto-hide capabilities
tasks.details: Enhance PropertyPanel with advanced layout features using react-resizable v3.0.5 and custom docking logic. Implement docking positions: left, right, bottom, floating window, and minimized to icon. Add resize functionality with: drag handles for panel resizing, minimum/maximum width constraints (200px min, 600px max), responsive breakpoints for mobile/tablet, and remembering size preferences in localStorage. Create auto-hide behavior with: hover to show when minimized, pin/unpin toggle, slide-in animation, and keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+P) to toggle. Build tabbed interface for multiple property panels when editing different element types simultaneously. Implement panel state persistence saving position, size, pinned state, and expanded sections to localStorage. Add panel animations using CSS transitions for smooth show/hide effects. Support multiple monitor setups with boundary detection.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests for docking positions and resize behavior. Test responsive breakpoints on different screen sizes. Verify state persistence across page refreshes. Test keyboard shortcuts and accessibility features.

tasks.title: Create property history and audit trail system
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive property change tracking with history visualization and audit trail capabilities
tasks.details: Build PropertyHistory.ts service in frontend/src/services/ for tracking all property changes. Implement history tracking: capture property changes with timestamp and user (when available), store old/new values for each change, group related changes into transactions, and limit history to last 100 changes per element. Create PropertyHistoryPanel component with: timeline view of property changes, diff view showing before/after values, filter by date range or property name, and restore to previous value functionality. Add audit trail features: change attribution (manual, calculated, template-applied), bulk change tracking with affected elements list, export history to JSON/CSV, and change statistics dashboard. Implement history optimization using circular buffer for memory efficiency, compression of repeated values, and periodic cleanup of old entries. Integrate with undo/redo system for property-specific rollback.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for history tracking and storage. Test memory usage with large history buffers. Integration tests for undo/redo with history. Verify audit trail accuracy and export functionality.

tasks.title: Develop property metadata and tooltip system
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive metadata system for properties with contextual help, tooltips, and documentation integration
tasks.details: Build PropertyMetadata.ts in frontend/src/types/ defining metadata structure for all properties. Implement metadata attributes: display name and description, units and precision settings, help text and examples, validation rules description, related properties links, and industry standard references. Create TooltipProvider component using native HTML5 tooltips enhanced with: rich content with formatting, images for visual guidance, calculation formula display, keyboard shortcut to show extended help (F1), and links to external documentation. Build property documentation system with: inline help icons next to fields, expandable help sections, context-sensitive help based on element type, and searchable help database. Add property categorization with: icon assignment per category, color coding for visual organization, custom category creation, and category-based filtering. Implement localization support for property names and help text (prepare structure, English only initially).
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for metadata retrieval and tooltip content generation. Test tooltip positioning and responsive behavior. Verify help system navigation and search functionality. Test localization structure with mock translations.

tasks.title: Build Advanced Minimap Component with LOD

tasks.title: Enhance Layer Domain Model and Database Schema
tasks.description: Extend the existing Layer entity in the backend Domain layer to support hierarchical structure, metadata, and element associations required for the comprehensive layers system
tasks.details: Enhance the Layer entity in Ergoplanner.Domain/Entities to include: parent-child relationships for nested layers, color coding, opacity settings, printable/selectable flags, element associations (nodes/edges), and metadata.
